The statement as relate 0.16.1 prints it in four of its output modes under an agent harness (`CLAUDECODE=1`), rendered from this page's recorded result by the terminal's renderers, which match the relate 0.16.1 binary byte for byte on the recorded runs. Exit code 0, as relate 0.16.1 returns it.

`--mode table` prints seven lines on stdout:

```bash
CLAUDECODE=1 relate --read-only --mode table "UNWIND ['Ada', 'Grace', 'Noor'] AS name RETURN name"
```

```text
+---------+
| name    |
+---------+
| "Ada"   |
| "Grace" |
| "Noor"  |
+---------+
```

`--mode envelope` prints one line on stdout:

```bash
CLAUDECODE=1 relate --read-only --mode envelope "UNWIND ['Ada', 'Grace', 'Noor'] AS name RETURN name"
```

```text
{"columnTypes":["STRING"],"columns":["name"],"notifications":[],"rows":[{"name":"Ada"},{"name":"Grace"},{"name":"Noor"}],"truncated":false}
```

`--mode jsonl` prints three lines on stdout:

```bash
CLAUDECODE=1 relate --read-only --mode jsonl "UNWIND ['Ada', 'Grace', 'Noor'] AS name RETURN name"
```

```text
{"name":"Ada"}
{"name":"Grace"}
{"name":"Noor"}
```

`--mode toon` prints four lines on stdout:

```bash
CLAUDECODE=1 relate --read-only --mode toon "UNWIND ['Ada', 'Grace', 'Noor'] AS name RETURN name"
```

```text
rows[3]{name}:
  Ada
  Grace
  Noor
```

Under a detected agent harness, relate prints at most 100 rows per statement; this statement returns three rows, so the cap leaves it whole.
